# Hybrid Work Program
[under: Hybrid Work Program] OCC operates under a Hybrid Work Program which, absent an approved exception, requires employees to work from an OCC office at least 3 days per week.
[under: Hybrid Work Program] To maximize in–person collaboration, Tuesday and Wednesday are considered anchor days, and all employees are expected to work in the office both days.
[under: Hybrid Work Program] Employees meeting performance expectations are generally permitted to select 2 other days per week to work remotely if desired.
[under: Hybrid Work Program] When working remotely, employees are generally expected to work from the state in which they reside, absent an exception approved by Human Resources.
[under: About the Intern Program] Interns work up to 40 hours per week in a hybrid work environment, and overtime is not permitted.
